description: Build all 5 subpages: /commodities, /province, /ai-assistant, /weather, /news, plus the /admin panel page. Each page is a full-featured view with charts, data tables, and interactive elements.
steps: Create app/commodities/page.tsx - Full commodity dashboard: page header, commodity price cards grid (Gabah, Jagung, Singkong, Cabai, Jahe), large area chart showing price history using Recharts (AreaChart), market insight section with AI analysis text, trend indicators, filter/sort options UI

Create app/province/page.tsx - Province agriculture data page: page header, Indonesia map SVG with provinces highlighted, province selector dropdown, comparison table (columns: Provinsi, Produksi Padi, Produksi Jagung, Luas Lahan, Produktivitas), bar chart comparing provinces using Recharts (BarChart), detail cards for each province

Create app/ai-assistant/page.tsx - Full AI chat interface: chat container with message history, input field with send button, pre-built question suggestions, simulated AI responses about agriculture (recommendations for planting, fertilizer, weather analysis, crop diseases), clean ChatGPT-style UI with message bubbles, typing indicator animation

Create app/weather/page.tsx - Weather dashboard: current conditions card (temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind), 7-day forecast cards, farming calendar/recommendations based on weather, seasonal planting guide, weather alerts section, charts for rainfall trends using Recharts (BarChart)

Create app/news/page.tsx - News listing page: grid of news cards (6 articles), category filter tabs (Padi, Cuaca, Teknologi, AI Pertanian, Komoditas), each card has thumbnail, title, excerpt, category badge, date, pagination UI

Create app/admin/page.tsx - Simple admin panel: article list table with edit/delete actions, 'Tambah Artikel' button, form for creating/editing articles (title, category, content textarea, thumbnail upload placeholder), publish/draft toggle, basic CRUD UI (client-side state only, no backend)
acceptance_criteria: /commodities page shows commodity cards with prices and a large chart
/province page has SVG map, comparison table, and bar chart
/ai-assistant page has functional chat UI with simulated responses
/weather page shows current conditions, forecast, and recommendations
/news page shows 6 articles with category filters
/admin page has article management table and create/edit form
All pages are responsive and support dark mode
All pages use consistent layout and navigation (Navbar visible)
Charts use Recharts with proper ResponsiveContainer wrapping
All pages have proper metadata/title for SEO
verification: Verify all page.tsx files exist in their respective app/ directories
Check that each page exports a default component
Verify Recharts imports are correct and data is properly typed
Confirm all pages use 'use client' directive where needed (interactive components)
